intro: Okay, Kiko. Just get the guidelines memo.
Don't let him see you sweat.
The Acting Editor-in-Chief. I assume you're here to tell me you've given up?
It would save us both a lot of time.
Actually, Sir, I'm here for the official formatting guidelines memo.
We're finalizing the editorial, and I want to ensure every margin and indent follows your standards. No excuses.
Guidelines? Most of your predecessors preferred 'artistic expression' over professional discipline.
Collaborate with the Student Council President to get actual data before I hand you the memo. I never condone misinformation.
outro: The alignment is clean. The demands and evidence are clear. I suppose I cannot reject a file that follows publication style guides so... religiously.
Enjoy this minor victory, Acting Editor. Let's see if you can maintain this discipline tomorrow.
